notes: Rasterio/GDAL is offline evidence tooling only; Symthaea runtime remains GIS-dependency-free.
The first promotable lane pins Rasterio 1.4.4 because PyPI publishes an exact CPython-3.13 Linux wheel digest and trusted-publishing provenance for that artifact.
Changing Python, Rasterio, GDAL/PROJ behavior, the wheel digest, or materialization policy creates a new evidence lineage.
A newer Rasterio release may be adopted later only through a new pinned toolchain lineage and parity campaign.
